report:
Salivary gland, left parotid, ultrasound-guided fine needle aspiration

Received are two air-dried and two alcohol-fixed smears and a needle rinse (blood-stained), processed as cytospin (1 slide) and cell block (1 block).

The smears (4 slides), cytospin (1 slide) and cell block (1 slide) are adequate for evaluation and show chondromyxoid fibrillary matrix, bland myoepithelial cells and plasmacytoid cells. Features are those of a pleomorphic adenoma.

SALIVARY GLAND, left parotid, ultrasound-guided fine needle aspiration - PLEOMORPHIC ADENOMA (Milan IVa: Benign neoplasm)
